spec.name: torsion_shaft_bracket
spec.description: 160 x 80 x 80 mm steel shaft bracket. x=0 end fixed to gearbox; 40 N*m torque about +x applied at x=160 through two 16x16 mm drive lugs (top y=80 and bottom y=0 edges, centred z=40) as an equal-and-opposite z force couple. Lever arm between lug centres = 72 - 8 = 64 mm, so F = 40000 N*mm / 64 mm = 625 N per lug. Right-hand rule M_x = (y-40)*Fz: top lug +z, bottom lug -z.

supports.note: x=0 end bolted rigidly to gearbox

loads.note: Top lug flush with y=80; +z half of the 40 N*m couple (64 mm arm)
Bottom lug flush with y=0; -z half of the 40 N*m couple (64 mm arm)

passive.note: Keep material under the top drive lug
Keep material under the bottom drive lug
